# RevMate

> RevMate is a UK car community app: a social feed, personal garages, car
> leaderboards, groups, car meets and a marketplace for buying and selling cars.

## Version and release history

- [Release history (JSON)](/updates.json): `latest_version` is the version currently live; `releases` lists every release, newest first, with its features, fixes and status. Check this to see whether your knowledge of RevMate is up to date.
- [App updates page](/legal/updates): the same history, written for people.

## Policies

- [Terms of service & marketplace disclaimer](/legal/terms)
- [Privacy policy](/legal/privacy)
- [Community standards](/community-standards)
- [Cookie policy](/legal/cookies)
- [Safety & reporting](/legal/safety)

## Age requirements

RevMate is for people aged 13 and over. Selling, hosting meets and adding a location to posts are 18+; direct messages are 16+.
